races.name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk EBF Junior "National Hunt" Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mistral St Georges
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with question marks over recent form but good going conditions.

runners_data.name: Planters Punch
runners_data.note: Perfect recent record on similar going with proven prominent style that suits likely pace scenario.

runners_data.name: Saxons Pride
runners_data.note: Highest-rated with strong recent form and hold-up style that needs gaps in small field.

runners_data.name: Crack Ops
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with solid recent form but needs to prove stamina at this trip.

runners_data.name: Molly's Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who has struggled on similar going previously despite decent recent efforts.

runners_data.name: Pippin's Legend
runners_data.note: Sole leader whose modest rating is offset by uncontested early advantage.

runners_data.name: Masterfield
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated with inconsistent recent form but prominent style keeps him competitive.

races.paceDynamic: Pippin's Legend will set the early tempo from the front with no other confirmed leaders, creating a sustainable rhythm that won't compromise stamina. The prominent runners Planters Punch, Crack Ops, and Mistral St Georges will track close behind, while hold-up horses Saxons Pride and Molly's Lad rely on finding gaps late in what could become a messy finish with multiple hold-up types converging.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If Pippin's Legend maintains steady fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest throughout allowing proven stayers to show their worth. Saxons Pride and Molly's Lad get ideal setups to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Planters Punch and Crack Ops apply early pressure to Pippin's Legend
scenarios.body: The tempo quickens from halfway as prominent runners battle for position. Hold-up horses find too much to do as the race develops into a staying test from the front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Early Becomes Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Pippin's Legend goes too steady and the field bunches up approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with all seven still in contention turning for home. The best turn of foot wins rather than stamina or race position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Pippin's Legend gets soft fractions and the field fails to close him down
scenarios.body: Despite his lower rating, the leader builds an unassailable advantage as chasers leave it too late. The hold-up horses never get into striking range.

watchPoints.text: Saxons Pride getting boxed in behind the leaders as multiple hold-up horses converge in the straight
Pippin's Legend setting fractions too fast if Planters Punch or Crack Ops press early
The jumping of Molly's Lad and Saxons Pride at the final two flights as they need clean passages
Planters Punch's stamina reserves if forced to make his move before the final furlong
How aggressively Crack Ops positions himself given his inconsistent finishing record

runners_data.name: Escort'kheops
runners_data.note: Unopposed leader but recent form shows inconsistency with only one win from last five starts

runners_data.name: Daly Boy
runners_data.note: Highest-rated hold-up horse who needs the pace to collapse to be effective

runners_data.name: Slim Marvel
runners_data.note: Natural prominent runner but poor recent form on heavy going may have knocked confidence

runners_data.name: Geordie Night
runners_data.note: Course winner who runs best when getting competitive racing from hold-up positions

runners_data.name: Golden Prince
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up horse with fresh legs but unproven at this distance

runners_data.name: Coumeenoole
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with stamina for the trip but lacks a recent win

runners_data.name: Woodview Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent course form but needs everything to fall right

runners_data.name: Ocean Walz
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner but showed glimpses of form when second at this course

runners_data.name: Parliamo
runners_data.note: Mid-division runner who can adapt tactics and has the best recent course form

races.paceDynamic: Escort'kheops will lead unopposed from the start with Slim Marvel and Coumeenoole settling prominent but not pressuring the leader. The five hold-up horses (Daly Boy, Geordie Night, Golden Prince, Woodview Lad, Ocean Walz) create a large pack that needs the pace to collapse, while Parliamo sits mid-division as the swing runner.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Escort'kheops maintains a solid gallop and the prominent horses don't fold
scenarios.body: The leader's class advantage tells as hold-up horses find too much to do from the back. Escort'kheops stays clear while Slim Marvel and Coumeenoole battle for the places.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and the race falls apart up front
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup with Daly Boy's class shining through late. Geordie Night's proven course form brings him into contention as the pace dies.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Cracks
scenarios.trigger: If Escort'kheops hits the front too early or the prominent horses apply pressure
scenarios.body: The leader's recent inconsistent form shows as he fades, allowing Parliamo to strike from his ideal position. Coumeenoole's stamina kicks in for a late challenge from the prominent group.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy scramble with multiple pace angles
scenarios.body: The chaotic nature allows an outsider like Ocean Walz or Golden Prince to exploit gaps and positioning. Either the lowest-rated runner finds his niche or Golden Prince's fresh legs tell.

watchPoints.text: Escort'kheops must be monitored for early signs of distress given his recent inconsistent efforts
The gap between Slim Marvel/Coumeenoole and the hold-up pack will determine if late runners get into contention
Daly Boy's jumping - if fluent he becomes the main danger but any mistakes leave him too much to do
Parliamo's position turning in - if he's closer than usual he becomes a major threat
Ocean Walz for each-way value if staying handy to the pace rather than being held up

runners_data.name: Seekingrainbows
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with finishing concerns who may struggle even if pace sets up perfectly

runners_data.name: Halftheworldaway
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner besides leader, giving her tactical advantage in most scenarios

runners_data.name: Highland Haven
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer who should relish the likely steady pace setup

runners_data.name: Toni's Legacy
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but recent form suggests she's not quite competitive at this level

runners_data.name: Jollie Dame
runners_data.note: Good recent form and hold-up style makes her major beneficiary of expected pace shape

runners_data.name: Roses All The Way
runners_data.note: Lone leader whose stamina-laden pedigree suits this trip and tactical situation

races.paceDynamic: Roses All The Way will take them along at a steady pace from the front, uncontested through the early stages with five hold-up horses and only Halftheworldaway likely to race prominently. This creates a sustainable tempo that should set up perfectly for the closers, with the real racing beginning from the second-last hurdle when the field bunches up behind the lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Roses All The Way maintains steady fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace stays even throughout allowing hold-up horses to get organized and deliver their challenge from the back. Highland Haven and Jollie Dame can time their runs perfectly in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Roses All The Way finds another gear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader uses her stamina to stretch the field and stays clear of late challenges. Halftheworldaway emerges as best of the rest but cannot quite get there.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the steady tempo becomes crawling speed in the straight
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where the prominent runner has every advantage. Halftheworldaway capitalizes on her forward position while closers get caught flat-footed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantities Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If After The Ball or She Can Run show significant improvement
scenarios.body: One of the lightly raced mares produces a career-best performance in this favorable pace scenario. The established form horses fail to capitalize on the setup.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Halftheworldaway decides to press Roses All The Way early as this would completely change the race dynamic
Monitor how quickly Highland Haven and Jollie Dame begin their moves as they need time to wind up from the back
Check if After The Ball or She Can Run race more prominently than expected given their unknown running styles
Observe Roses All The Way's jumping rhythm as any mistakes could bring the field closer than ideal
Watch for Seekingrainbows getting outpaced if the tempo increases, confirming her stamina limitations

races.paceDynamic: Bleu d'Enfer will lead with Nativehill, Doyouknowwhatimean, Kahavari and The Good Doctor tracking prominently in the early stages. With five hold-up horses (Anyharminasking, Busty Boy, Lady Jago, Palamon, Rule Me In) at the back, this creates a solid pace that will test stamina over this extended trip, favoring those who can sustain their effort from the front or prominent positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace favors leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Bleu d'Enfer and the prominent runners maintain honest gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The pace becomes searching enough to stretch the field but not collapse the leaders. Those tracking close benefit from the strong pace breaking up the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical slow early pace
scenarios.trigger: If Bleu d'Enfer goes too steady and prominent horses don't commit early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes messy with the five hold-up horses getting into contention turning for home. This creates a sprint finish that favors the stronger closers with best closing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bleu d'Enfer dominates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Bleu d'Enfer uses superior rating to control race from the front without pressure
scenarios.body: The leader dictates terms and kicks clear turning for home with only the best staying prominent horses able to respond. Hold-up horses left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse of early pace
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners go too fast early and tie up in final half-mile
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable causing leaders to weaken dramatically in closing stages. Patient hold-up horses sweep past tired leaders in final furlong with strongest finishers prevailing.

watchPoints.text: Bleu d'Enfer's jumping under pressure - any mistakes when challenged could end chances quickly
How aggressively Doyouknowwhatimean and Kahavari track the leader early - too keen could backfire
Whether Anyharminasking gets proper race setup from hold-up position with searching pace needed
Nativehill's fitness on return - prominent runners need to be ready from flag-fall in this company
Rule Me In's early positioning - lowest rating means needs every break to feature

races.paceDynamic: Subtle Fortune leads uncontested with five prominent runners (Good Work, Felton Bellevue, Streamsforth Lad, Nine Nine Nine, I See The Sea) creating a wall behind the leader. This congestion will cause severe traffic problems turning for home, favoring either Subtle Fortune if he sustains or the three hold-up horses who can find cleaner passages late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Subtle Fortune Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains his jumping and stamina holds over 3m
scenarios.body: Subtle Fortune controls throughout while the prominent pack gets messy behind him. The hold-up horses struggle to make up enough ground as the pace becomes steady rather than collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If the five-horse prominent group goes too hard chasing Subtle Fortune early
scenarios.body: Pace pressure tells on leaders turning in, creating perfect setup for closers. The Scorpion King and Three Zambezi's get dream runs through tired horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Decides
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes multiple interference incidents 2-3 out
scenarios.body: Clean jumpers with room benefit while others get hampered or brought down. I See The Sea's class tells if getting a clear run, otherwise it's whoever avoids trouble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Sneaks Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and an unfancied hold-up horse gets perfect late run
scenarios.body: New Invention or Three Zambezi's finds the gaps that elude higher-rated closers. The prominent horses tie up completely leaving the race to patient riders.

watchPoints.text: Watch for multiple fallers or interference when the prominent pack hits the business end 2-3 out
Monitor Subtle Fortune's jumping rhythm - any mistake will invite immediate pressure from the pack behind
Check if Three Zambezi's shows usual late fade pattern or stays on for once over this longer trip
Look for I See The Sea getting clear run - has class to win if avoiding the traffic problems
Watch New Invention early - if closer than usual could signal connections expect strong run

runners_data.name: Service Minimum
runners_data.note: Highest official rating and proven hold-up performer who excels when getting a strong pace to aim at

runners_data.name: Morning Air
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter but poor recent form suggests vulnerability if pressed or in a finish

runners_data.name: Eastern Shores
runners_data.note: Consistent performer who showed good form earlier this year and suits this trip when held up

runners_data.name: Voodoo Angel
runners_data.note: Handy performer who can race prominently and has been running well in similar company recently

runners_data.name: Rock On Cassie

runners_data.name: Nevershedatear

races.paceDynamic: Morning Air will likely lead or share the early pace with Voodoo Angel, creating a moderate tempo through the early stages. With most runners preferring to be held up (Service Minimum, Roaring Home, Eastern Shores, Rock On Cassie, Nevershedatear), the pace should be sustainable early before intensifying from the home turn as the hold-up horses make their moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Morning Air and Voodoo Angel set a steady tempo without pressure
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get ideal racing conditions with plenty to aim at from the back. Service Minimum and Roaring Home can time their challenges perfectly in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast early trying to dominate
scenarios.body: Morning Air and Voodoo Angel burn each other out with an unsustainable gallop. The best stayers among the hold-up brigade capitalize on the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front End Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Morning Air gets an uncontested lead and conserves energy
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an advantage that proves hard to peg back despite late challenges. Voodoo Angel stays on to pick up the pieces as hold-up horses find too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Muddling Affair
scenarios.trigger: If no horse takes clear control and the pace becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with positioning crucial. The most adaptable horses who can quicken from any position hold the key.

watchPoints.text: Morning Air's jumping under pressure - recent poor form suggests confidence issues if challenged for the lead
Service Minimum's ability to get a clear run from the back given the small field may bunch up on the turn
Voodoo Angel's positioning early - whether she sits behind Morning Air or tries to make it a pace battle
The overall pace through the middle stages - if it becomes too slow it favors the more tactical runners
Eastern Shores finding her old form - she showed promise earlier in the year but needs to recapture that level
